title: Completion of a strict henselization is flat
statement: Let R be a Noetherian local ring and let R^{\mathrm{sh}} be its strict henselization with respect to a chosen separable closure of the residue field [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples]. For the maximal-ideal completion \widehat{R^{\mathrm{sh}}}=\varprojlim_n R^{\mathrm{sh}}/(\mathfrak mR^{\mathrm{sh}})^n, the canonical map R^{\mathrm{sh}}\to\widehat{R^{\mathrm{sh}}} is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].
